Title: Unicode table headers break the pretty-printer

Reproduction (fails every time on Python 3.12):

    from tinydb_demo.pretty import render_table
    print(render_table([{'title': 'Tiếng Việt', 'count': 1}]))

Actual output misaligns the columns and leaves mojibake:

    Tiếng Việt  ??
    --------    --

Expected: columns padded with display width (wcwidth), not len().
Stack: pretty.py:31 render_table -> pretty.py:57 _pad_header uses len(header).
